denormals: x86 MXCSR FTZ/DAZ enabled locally, restored at exit
callback_cpu_scope: existing timed callback plus its two wall-clock reads; excludes controller synthesis, Stats, verification and warmup
callback_cpu_rtf_definition: callback thread CPU seconds / rendered audio seconds; not system CPU percent
callback_cpu_comparison_rule: instrument baseline and candidate identically; extra clock reads add overhead
timed_scope: setControlFrame, active control events, render; no JUCE/DAW/driver
